The estate's vehicle gate is not in the venue's quest-driven device list; only the intercom trigger and interior single doors are known. Tour should confirm the gate is closed in free roam and how vanilla lets the player through (intercom, guard reaction, security-system quickhack), so the restricted state is genuinely vanilla and not accidental.

Guard attitude on sight is expected to be hostile to a trespasser; tour should record whether the gate sentry and patrols are alert or merely standing, so the stop does not flag ALERT/HOSTILE if the owner wants a neutral curtilage.
